**Newsletter**

Dear Shift Workers,

We're excited to announce a new shift for you! Starting October 6, we'll be opening at 10 am instead of 9 am. This change is a result of our commitment to providing you with the best service, and we want to make sure you're ready for it.

To help you prepare, we've established a new block of time for you. From now on, you can expect this time to be dedicated to you, and it won't be interrupted by other activities.

We hope this shift works for you and that you're ready to join us at 10 am on October 6. We look forward to welcoming you!

Sincerely,  
Founder
